note: Ratchet baseline. Lower is the only legal direction. Regenerate deliberately with tools/check_independence.py --update.

deliberate_increases.why: Reflex's own key-value store used raw esp_rom_spiflash_* to hold this tier at 1, and that is exactly why it persisted nothing: raw ROM flash access while the CPU executes XIP from the same flash never reaches the medium. The count was protecting a store that silently lost every key it was given — aura pairing impossible, purpose gone by the next boot. Independence measured as subtraction rewarded that; make parity-diff, which measures capability, did not.
deliberate_increases.evidence: With the dependency: parity-diff reports 0 capability regressions for both the independence build and the own-entry build against stock ESP-IDF. Without it: 1, persistence.
